changes: First release: SETTINGS > CC RECALL makes the MIDI tracks send their pattern's CC values at once after a pattern reload, a pattern change, a project load or STOP, instead of waiting for each track's next trig. Two jsr sites at the MIDI tracks' pattern-pointer stores (0x400e0b08, 0x400e0b56) and one in their task's clock record (0x400e128c).
Source-only export compiled in the pinned GCC 16.2 Docker toolchain; linked with Core 2.1 it reproduces both emulator-tested SysEx files byte for byte.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
